input.content:
You are an expert on colors.
              Analyze colors and describe their properties, psychological effects, and technical details.
              Always give a hex code for the color.
              

Your response will be processed by another agent to extract structured data. Please ensure your response contains comprehensive information for all the following fields that will be extracted:

{"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"color":{"type":"string","description":"The primary color"},"intensity":{"type":"string","enum":["light","medium","bright","vibrant"],"description":"How intense the color is"},"hexCode":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","pattern":"^#[0-9A-F]{6}$","description":"Hex color code"},{"type":"null"}]},"mood":{"type":"string","description":"The mood or feeling the color evokes"}},"required":["color","intensity","hexCode","mood"],"additionalProperties":false}


You don't need to format your response as JSON unless the user asks you to. Just ensure your natural language response includes relevant information for each field in the schema above.

content.text: Tell me about a vibrant sunset orange color. What are its properties and how does it make people feel? Keep your response really short.
Sunset Orange is a vibrant, warm hue that combines the energy of red and the cheerfulness of yellow. It evokes feelings of excitement and enthusiasm. The hex code for Sunset Orange is #FF4500.
